route.caption_rule: first line = the searchable GTA 6 fact in the words people type as a question: an everyday/real-life action + 'in GTA 6' ('brushing your teeth in GTA 6', 'dying in GTA 6 takes your money', 'GTA 6 cars run out of gas'); streamer name early, 1 emoji, then the quote; 3-4 hashtags incl. #gta6. Avoid 'first time'/'bet'/'tried to' openers - they aren't searched (2-14 views, 11-21).
